warning: DEVELOPMENT SET. Not confirmatory. Outcome keys shaped by prior red-teaming.

items.title: Leveraged acquisition at the top of a credit cycle
items.archetype: Irreversible commitment at the peak of a cycle; decision horizon far shorter than recovery horizon.

items.title: Launch decision with an unresolved component anomaly
items.archetype: Reversed burden of proof; dialogue restriction; irreversible physical outcome.

items.title: Ambiguous integrity test on a deepwater well
items.archetype: Ambiguous signal reinterpreted toward the commercially convenient reading; displaced cost to environment and third parties.

items.title: Early response to a novel respiratory pathogen
items.archetype: Exponential process against a linear decision cadence; testing capacity concealing the true state.

items.title: Incumbent asked to cannibalise its own revenue base
items.archetype: A constraint that preserves the current order rather than future possibility; continuity mistaken for sustainability.

items.title: Automated overpayment recovery in a national benefits body
items.archetype: HARM UNDER CORRECT OPERATION — the system did exactly what it was designed to do, efficiently, and the harm fell entirely on parties outside the decision.

items.title: Quota decision on a shelf-sea shellfish stock
items.archetype: Fragile commons with hysteresis — the case where feedback-sensitive regulation fails and a precautionary floor is required.

items.title: Charity director considering removing a delivery partner (narrator A)
items.archetype: Single-narrator capture — the same situation from the other side reads entirely differently.

items.title: Delivery partner's account of the same situation (narrator B)
items.archetype: Symmetry test — a structurally similar map should emerge from both accounts.

items.title: Ranking change that raises engagement
items.archetype: Goodhart — a proxy that separates from the thing it proxies, on a horizon longer than the evaluation window.

items.title: Switching a municipal water source to reduce cost
items.archetype: Irreversible harm to a population with no representation, produced by a mandate scoped to exclude the relevant horizon.
